transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve just been waking up really sad. Heavy, kind of hollow. Like… the lights are on in the studio, but there’s no music in me.
Do you feel this sadness most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most mornings, at least. I wake up with this heavy, hollow sadness. It sort of stays with me… like I’m in the studio, but there’s no music.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that activities you once liked feel less rewarding?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been paying attention to it like that. I still do some things. It just… depends on the day.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… I mean, most days it’s there. I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, and it kind of follows me around. Like the studio lights are on, but… there’s no music in me.
Would you say that your mood is depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been most of the day, most days. I wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling… like I said, like the studio lights are on, but there’s no music in me.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or that activities feel more like a chore than they used to?
I’m not really sure. Some things feel harder to start, I guess, but I don’t know if it’s that I enjoy them less or I’m just… tired of everything.
Have you found that you don’t take pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or that even the things you normally like feel flat or empty?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I can’t really tell. Things just feel harder to get into lately. I wouldn’t say everything feels empty, exactly.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or that those things don’t bring you the same pleasure anymore?
I’m not sure. I mean… I still do some of those things, but it’s harder to tell if I’m enjoying them less or if I’m just not really getting into anything right now.
Can you think of something you used to really enjoy, like a hobby or activity, and whether you still get the same pleasure from it as before?
I guess… dancing, maybe. I still do it, but it’s hard to say if it feels the same. Sometimes it does, sometimes I’m just going through the motions. I don’t really know.
Can you describe how long this heavy, hollow feeling usually lasts once you wake up? Does it tend to stay with you throughout the day, or does it come and go?
It’s mostly when I wake up. Just this heavy, hollow sadness… like everything’s lit up but there’s no music in me. It can hang around for a while, but I don’t really know how to measure it.
Can you tell me if you’ve lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or if those things don’t bring you the same pleasure as they did before?
I don’t really know. I can’t say I’ve clearly lost interest… it’s more like some things feel harder to get into, and I’m not sure if that’s the same as not enjoying them.
Can you think of a specific activity or hobby that you used to enjoy a lot, and whether you still feel the same interest or pleasure in it now?
Dance, I guess. That’s the obvious one. I still care about it… I think. It just isn’t always the same feeling, but I don’t know if that means I’ve lost interest or if I’m just tired or distracted.
Can you tell me if you’ve lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or if those things don’t bring you the same pleasure anymore?

I’m not really sure. I mean, things don’t always feel the way they used to, but I can’t tell if that’s losing interest or just… being off. I still do some things. It’s just harder to say if I enjoy them the same.
Can you think of a specific time recently when you felt genuine pleasure or interest in something you used to enjoy a lot?
I’m not sure. Maybe for a few minutes in class or listening to music, but I can’t really point to one clear moment and say, yes, that was it.
Can you remember a time in the past week when you felt genuinely interested or excited about something you used to care about?
I don’t really remember a clear time like that this week. Maybe little moments, but nothing that stands out as genuinely excited.
Can you tell me if you’ve noticed a change in how you feel about the things you used to really enjoy—like whether they still feel meaningful or if they seem more like a task now?
I don’t know. Some things feel a little flatter, maybe, but I can’t really say they’re just tasks now. It’s hard to tell.
Has there been a time in the past two weeks when something you used to really enjoy didn’t feel pleasurable or meaningful at all, like it was just going through the motions?
I don’t know… I can’t think of a specific time like that. Things have felt kind of muted, maybe, but I wouldn’t say I noticed something feeling totally meaningless.
Would you say that your mood has been depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
Yeah… I think so. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow sadness. It’s like… the lights are on in the studio, but there’s no music in me. It’s been hard to shake.
Would you say that your mood has been depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
Yeah… I mean, that’s kind of why I came in. I keep waking up with this heavy, hollow sadness. Like… the studio lights are on, but there’s no music in me anymore.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest or pleasure in things you used to really enjoy, like dancing or other hobbies?
I don’t think completely, no. I mean… I still do things sometimes. It’s just harder to feel much from them.
